newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey down as Hoare repeats sell.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey down as Hoare repeats sell.

text.p: Shares in Johnson Matthey Plc dipped on Monday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated a "sell" rating on the stock and said earnings estimates in the market could be subject to downwards pressure, traders said.
Against the trend of a rising UK equity market, Matthey shares were down 5-1/2p at 533-1/2 by 1342 GMT in thin volume of just 15,343 shares.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.

Last month Hoare Govett analysts cut their pretax profit estimate for the precious metals and speciality materials company for the year to March 1997 to 108 million stg from 118 million, citing soft demand for ceramic products and weak platinum prices.
